reader.requirement: At --std 85 the RELATIVE KEY operand of a relative file (any access mode) must be a numeric, unsigned, integer data item whose PICTURE has no P (leading or trailing); signed, fractional, P-scaled, alphanumeric, alphabetic, edited, group, index and condition-name operands must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 selects Rules85: the 1985 rows (RelativeKeyUnsignedInteger, TableElementSubscripted, RelativeKeyNotInRecord) REPLACE SR-12.4.5.13.3-1/-2/-3

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Supersedes in FileControlKeyRules.cs; the 1985 row's predicate (Pic is {Category Numeric, Scale 0, Signed false}) is the same as the 2023 row it supersedes, only the message/citation differ.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the 1985 row's predicate equals the 2023 SR2 row's; at 2002 only the OCCURS row differs (subscripts admitted), not this rule.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb5627 signed and pb5801 level 66; not exercised: P-scaled, fractional, alphanumeric, group, index, edited, OCCURS, the legal COMP form at run time.

probes.printed: COBOL0863 RELATIVE KEY 'KS' must reference an unsigned integer data item ... (ANSI §1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR2)

probes.expected: refused: index item is not a numeric integer data item

probes.printed: COBOL0863 'KT' is subject to an OCCURS clause ... (ANSI §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4)
COBOL1639 'K88' is declared as a condition-name
0003 CCCC 00 / IK 23 / 0001 AAAA 00 / 0003 CCCC 00 / EOF 10 (DYNAMIC: random READ, failed READ, START, READ NEXT updating the key)
probes.expected: legal; record 2 absent gives invalid key 23; sequential READ NEXT returns the relative record number in RK

citations.check: python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR2" "must reference an unsigned integer data item whose description does not contain the PICTURE symbol" -> OK §1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR2

reader.notes: The 1985 row ClauseOperandRules1985.RelativeKeyUnsignedInteger replaces the 2023 SR2 row below 2002 with the same predicate (numeric, scale 0 so no P either side and no fraction, unsigned); every refusal form was refused and the legal COMP key drives RANDOM, DYNAMIC, START and READ NEXT correctly.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: rkbwz (PIC 9(4) BLANK WHEN ZERO, numeric edited per §1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2) COBOL0863; rksgn (S9(4) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE) COBOL0863; rkseqs (SEQUENTIAL access, S9(4)) COBOL0863, so the screen covers the optional SEQUENTIAL RELATIVE KEY too; rk66 (66 RENAMES THRU, a group) COBOL0863; rkpk (PACKED-DECIMAL) and rkseqbin (BINARY, DYNAMIC) compile, both 1985 usages; rkseqrun (SEQUENTIAL access, PACKED-DECIMAL key, WRITE x2 then READ x3) MATCH 'W 0001 00 / W 0002 00 / R 0001 AAAA 00 / R 0002 BBBB 00 / EOF 10'. cite.py --check "§1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR2" "unsigned integer data item whose description does not contain" -> OK.
